Experience this timeless Golden Age masterpiece fully remastered in 4K Ultra HD (2160p)!


THE PLOT:

In a conservative Venetian commercial school for girls, a timid teacher attempts to instruct her class in business correspondence by drafting a sample love letter addressed to a fictional businessman named "Mr. Alfredo Hartman." Mischievous student Maddalena (Carla Del Poggio) decides to actually mail the passionate letter as a joke.

Unbeknownst to anyone, a real Alfredo Hartman (Vittorio De Sica) actually exists—a wealthy, handsome businessman in Vienna. Intrigued and flattered by the mysterious declaration of love, Hartman travels to Italy to find the unknown sender. What follows is a delightful series of misunderstandings, mistaken identities, and romantic sparks as Hartman searches for his secret admirer inside the girl's academy.


A GOLDEN AGE ITALIAN COMEDY IN 4K:

Directed by Vittorio De Sica and written by Ferruccio Biancini, László Kádár, and Miklos Kadar, "Maddalena, Zero for Conduct" is a landmark film of the "white telephone" (Telefoni Bianchi) era of Italian cinema. Featuring charming performances by Vittorio De Sica, Vera Bergman, and Carla Del Poggio, this 4K remastered edition restores every frame to crystal-clear visual perfection.
